    shared TAIL, not an entry, and analysing it as one reports a `ret` that is perfectly correct.
    An entry is a label something CALLS (`bl`/`call`), or a global nothing branches to at all,
    which is how the program's own code enters the runtime.
    """
    text = path.read_text()
    globals_ = set(re.findall(r'^\\s*\\.globl\\s+([A-Za-z_][\\w.$]*)', text, re.M))
    called = set(re.findall(r'^\\s*(?:bl|call)\\s+([A-Za-z_][\\w.$]*)\\s*$', text, re.M))
    branched = set(re.findall(r'^\\s*(?:b|jmp)\\s+([A-Za-z_][\\w.$]*)\\s*$', text, re.M))
